description: Modal dialog over a blurred scrim. Takes the whole interaction until dismissed.

open.description: Whether the dialog is shown. The host owns it.

title.description: Names the dialog for assistive technology and heads it visually. Required: aria-labelledby points at it, and a modal with no name is worse than none at all.

eyebrow.description: A short kicker above the title.

width.description: A CSS width for the panel. It defaults to 480px, which each layer reaches its own way -- React as this expression on the panel's inline style, Angular as its recipe's own width class -- and the input overrides whichever.

close.description: The dialog was dismissed -- by Escape or by a scrim click. No payload.
